data.gender_notes: Maktoonah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Maktoobah' which means 'honeycomb'. It is a name that represents beauty, grace and the sweetness of life. The name Maktoonah carries the meaning “Honeycomb” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Maktoonah usually hope their child will grow to embody honeycomb and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unity, harmony and the order of the universe.
data.etymology: Maktoonah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honeycomb.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maktoonah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مكتونه
in_arabic.long_meaning: المكتونه: المكتونه هو الشخص المتميز من حيث الجود والطيب، ويستمد هذه الخواص من قوله تعالى في القران الكريم "يا أيها الذين آمَنوا أوفوا بالعهد ما عُدِتُم فيهِ فانظُرُوا كيف أخَلَيتُم مُحَمِدَةَ بنتِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَلِبِ وَزَوَّجُوهَا لِأَبيها وَما حَلَلَ لَكُم أَن تَتَّخِذُوا أَزْوَاجَكُم مُتَعَدِّياتٍ مِن بَعْدِ ما مَلَكتُمُها فَإِن كُنتُمْ فَعَلَت مُحَمِدَةَ خَطَأً فَإِنَّ اللَهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ" (التحريم: 1). ويُعتبر الفتى المتميز بالجود والطيب صفة مباركة في الإسلام، حيث يُشير إلى فاعل الخير والجود.

in_english.name: Maktoonah
in_english.long_meaning: Maktoonah: In Islamic tradition, Maktoonah refers to a person who is generous in showing hospitality to others. This refers to the person's ability to provide for and care for their guests, demonstrating their generosity and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Maktoonah' embodies the rich and diverse cultural heritage of the Islamic world. Honey, represented by the name, is a symbol of prosperity and sweetness in Middle Eastern tradition. The name Maktoonah connects us to this heritage, reminding us of the beauty and harmony of our shared cultural identity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the honeycomb is also believed to be a symbol of the universe. Just as each cell in a honeycomb contains sweet nectar, so too does each living being contain a spiritual essence. The name Maktoonah encourages us to recognize and cherish the spiritual essence within ourselves and others, and to strive for unity and harmony in our lives.
